title: Report store file helpers
responsibility: Resolves the report root, validates identifiers and reads or atomically replaces JSON files.

inputs.name: reportFiles.root
inputs.description: Optional report-store root override; when omitted, its value is undefined. A truthy value is returned directly, while an empty string falls through to PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME and then join(homedir(), '.codex', 'project-reports').

inputs.name: safeId.id
inputs.description: Report or asset identifier accepted only when it matches ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}$. Empty strings, non-ASCII characters, other punctuation, and values longer than 100 characters throw Error.

inputs.name: readJson.path
inputs.description: Path passed to readFile; the file is read as UTF-8 and parsed as JSON. The helper does not create the file or validate the parsed value against a runtime schema.

inputs.name: atomicJson.path
inputs.description: Destination path for the JSON file. Its parent directory is created recursively before the temporary file is renamed over this path.

inputs.name: atomicJson.data
inputs.description: Value passed to JSON.stringify with two-space indentation before writing. Cyclic data, BigInt values, or serialization hooks can make serialization fail, and JSON.stringify can omit or transform unsupported values.

outputs.name: reportFiles
outputs.description: Returns a string root path. A truthy root wins, then PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME, otherwise the result is join(homedir(), '.codex', 'project-reports'); an empty root does not override either fallback.

outputs.name: safeId
outputs.description: Returns the input string unchanged when it matches the accepted identifier pattern. Values outside that pattern throw Error with message Invalid report or asset ID.

outputs.name: readJson
outputs.description: Resolves with JSON.parse output cast to the requested T type. No runtime type or schema validation is performed.

outputs.name: atomicJson
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined after it creates parent directories recursively with mode 0700, writes two-space-formatted JSON to a UUID-suffixed temporary file with mode 0600, and renames that file over the destination.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: safeId throws Error with message Invalid report or asset ID when the identifier fails its pattern. Filesystem errors from readJson and atomicJson propagate.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: readJson rejects with SyntaxError when JSON.parse cannot parse the file contents.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: atomicJson can throw or reject with TypeError when JSON serialization fails for cyclic data or BigInt, or when writeFile receives an unsupported serialized result.
